reason: The main contribution is an RLVR training framework that shapes the model policy, not prompting or agents.
Di-Fusion is a self-supervised denoiser built on diffusion steps and adaptive sampling; no CNN is named.
NExT-OMNI is a large omnimodal foundation model doing any-to-any understanding and generation via discrete flow matching.
The method rescales CLIP image-text similarity scores, so vision and language are jointly central.
The paper is a dataset and benchmark that evaluates existing HPE models without naming their families.
INFER regresses continuous frequency response fields from measured acoustic responses with spectral supervision.
A lightweight gating policy on top of a planner is trained, but its model family is not named.
Circuit designs are optimized by evolution evaluated against a design evaluator rather than a fixed dataset type.
The paper is a theoretical analysis of GD dynamics on logistic and cross-entropy losses with no model built.
LMFusion adapts pretrained Llama-3 with parallel image modules trained with diffusion; the added modules are LLM-style copies.
CoMEL is built on a Grouped Double Attention Transformer for instance encoding with LoRA adaptation.
ART is a gradient-descent-ascent learning algorithm for MARL agents whose network family is not named.
Pallatom is a generative model of all-atom structures; the abstract names no graph or equivariant network.
AminoAseed improves codebook updates of a structure tokenizer, a vector-quantized autoencoder-style model.
The method extends flow-based latent protein generation architectures; no GNN or equivariant network is named.
SePer is an LLM-based evaluation metric for retrieval utility in RAG, which falls under RAG and LLM evaluation.
RxnFlow is trained with a GFlowNet objective but the network family of the policy is not named.
The method modifies ProtoPNet variants with image backbones; prototypes are part of that network, not a separate family.
The backbone combines SNN layers, an attention bridge, dense ANN conv blocks and DWConvLSTM RNN blocks.
The work analyses multimodal contrastive learning with latent variable models and runs experiments without naming encoder families.
BGT-ESRE is a graph transformer over brain connectivity graphs with edge-aware attention.
CODA is a multimodal clinical foundation model doing QA and report generation, i.e. a large language or vision-language model.
WISE is a hand-designed hierarchical and dictionary-based lossless compressor with no learned model.
The contribution is a training-free inference-time sampling algorithm to improve LLM reasoning.
Medex pairs natural-language facts with SMILES or RefSeq representations and models reason jointly over text and design targets.
The authors train LLM, CLIP and LLaVA architectures on the data and build it with LLM pipelines.
BioBO addresses design of genomic perturbation experiments, selecting interventions via Bayesian optimization.
The model takes EEG recordings as input and synthesizes fMRI from them.
UniEFS uses condition-aware prompt tokens with a pretrained fMRI decoder, a token-based transformer design.
SoLoPO is a new preference-optimization training objective that improves long-context ability and training efficiency.
Cello is a WSI framework for diagnosis and prognosis trained with WSI labels; contrastive learning is only a module.
SOCP fits a Self-Organizing Map, a neural network, to discover calibration groups.
Dyn-O is a world model evaluated on rollout prediction and imagined trajectory generation, not on policy learning.
The abstract describes an object-centric world model without naming its network family.
The paper studies verbal uncertainty quantification of LLMs and proposes VOCAL to fit marker-uncertainty mappings to correctness.
The MR block is a module for few-shot WSI classification with labels.
The MIL framework uses unbalanced transport for instance weighting but names no network family.
DART is an image generation model; text is conditioning and the generated data are images.
FLeRM is applied to MLPs with residual connections and transformers trained by the authors.
GeoR is a self-evaluation of correctness scored by AUROC, AUPR and FPR@95, i.e. error detection.
Bonobo trains a GFlowNet generative model whose network family is not named; GFlowNets are not diffusion or normalizing flows.
FlashIPA reformulates Invariant Point Attention, a geometry-aware invariant attention mechanism.
PoET-2 models protein sequences with only optional structure conditioning.
The data are activity measurements of pooled molecules such as antibodies.
The method is a neural compressed-sensing estimator that deconvolutes molecule-activity maps from pooled measurements.
The paper proves convergence of projected policy gradient with exact policy evaluations and uses no data.
The main contributions are differentially private algorithms for vaccination strategy design.
GALAX integrates GNNs into LLMs via reinforcement learning guided by a graph process reward model.
Core findings come from transformers trained on synthetic Markov-chain and modular-addition tasks.
The dataset benchmark evaluates models from linear to foundation models without the authors building a named model family.
